title: introduce-ephemeral-bootstrap-tokens-and-post-upgrade-rbac-reconciler
author: Maya Patel
description: Add Helm hooks and a lightweight reconciler job to enable ephemeral bootstrap credentials during Private installs and to reconcile RBAC bundles after upgrades. Motivation: long-lived bootstrap service accounts were causing over-permissive periods during installer runs and upgrades where tenant roles could drift. This change introduces an installer-side ephemeral-token flow, a post-upgrade Kubernetes Job hook that validates and repairs tenant-scoped Role/RoleBinding state, and Terraform/Helm changes to wire the flow for Private (VPC/on-prem) installations. Includes migration scripts, documentation updates, and rollout/rollback playbooks. The implementation aims to be idempotent and safe for air-gapped environments (no external network calls) and integrates with existing KMS/KMS-key references for secrets-in-transit. Manual steps for zero-downtime upgrade are documented in the PR body.

how_it_works: Installer optionally spins up a transient namespace and creates an ephemeral service account with narrowly scoped RoleBindings. The installer requests a short-lived token (ephemeral) via the controller and uses it only for the seed steps. After successful install/upgrade, the Helm post-upgrade Job runs the RBAC reconciler which verifies per-tenant Roles and RoleBindings against the policy bundle and repairs drifts. If enabled, the reconciler will emit audit events and generate a report in the installer artifacts bucket (or local tarball for air-gapped installs).
rollout_plan: Feature gated behind --enable-ephemeral-rbac and helm value private.ephemeralRBAC.enabled=false by default. Recommend staged rollout: 1) opt-in on staging clusters with synthetic tenants, 2) run upgrade with --enable-ephemeral-rbac=true and monitor reconciler report, 3) enable by default in next minor after 2 weeks of stable runs.
rollback: If issues are detected, run helm rollback for the release and then execute scripts/migrate/ephemeral-migration.sh --revert which will re-create previous long-lived SAs and re-seed bindings. The reconciler is no-op in revert mode. Also support an emergency flag --disable-post-upgrade-reconciler in installer.
migration_notes: Provided scripts/migrate/ephemeral-migration.sh to safely convert existing installations: it snapshots current RoleBindings, applies ephemeral bootstrap artifacts, and can restore state. For large fleets, recommend running in windowed batches.
